assertions.assertion: The model parent discovers both configured profiles and uses the advertised team_task plus worker lifecycle tools.
Exactly two parent-managed tasks are created, the second depends on the first, and it is not started before acceptance.
Guidance is accepted for the exact attached RUNNING implementation run with a durable running-delivery receipt.
The initial implementation succeeds and the first reviewer receives enough linked handoff evidence to mention VIOLET.
Exactly one requested correction reuses the implementation worker, links a new run to its previous run, and retains COBALT, VIOLET, and AMBER.
Two reviewer runs succeed and only the second review is accepted, leaving the implementation task done.
The dependent task starts after acceptance and its attached worker succeeds.
Every run uses its requested, resolved, and transmitted route with no worker tools, duplicate execution, authorization violation, structured tool error, or unacknowledged terminal result.
